card.line: Emmaus was a village about seven miles from Jerusalem, where two disciples walked and talked with the risen Jesus on the day of His resurrection.

moments.title: Two travelers leave Jerusalem
moments.text: On the day Jesus rose, two of His followers were walking to Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem. They talked with each other about everything that had happened.

moments.title: Jesus walks beside them
moments.text: Jesus Himself came up and walked with them, but their eyes were kept from recognizing Him. He asked what they were discussing, and they stood still with sadness on their faces.

moments.title: Cleopas tells about Jesus
moments.text: Cleopas asked Jesus if He was the only visitor to Jerusalem who did not know what had happened. They told Him about Jesus of Nazareth, a prophet powerful in speech and action before God and all the people.
